name: freeroute
description: Local-first, quota-aware routing for official LLM free tiers.

scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js serve
scripts.update: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js update
scripts.backup:keys: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js export-keys
scripts.restore:keys: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js import-keys
scripts.import:9router: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js import-9router
